remembrance.service_description: Part of the East Moor memorial programme. When RCAF representatives attend the annual service, additional events are organised including visits to Commonwealth War Graves near Harrogate and guided tours of Sutton Hall (wartime officers' mess). Three officers from 415 Squadron attended in 2025.
